category.name: Video generation and editing
category.description: Text/image-to-video models, talking avatars, programmatic video rendering and video hosting.

entries.name: Akool API
entries.auth_hint: x-api-key: <api_key> (or Client ID/Secret to obtain a token, then Authorization: Bearer <token>)
entries.free_tier: free Basic plan with limited credits, no card required
entries.desc_en: Generate face-swap, talking avatar, and video-translation content programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Credit-based usage across face swap, avatar video, image generation, video translation endpoints.

entries.name: Creatomate API
entries.desc_en: Programmatically generate and render videos/images from templates via REST API.
entries.notes: Per-project API keys; ~14 credits per minute of 720p video.

entries.name: D-ID API
entries.free_tier: 14-day trial with 3 minutes of video credits, then paid only (~$5.90/min API)
entries.desc_en: Animate photos into talking-head videos with lip-sync from text or audio via REST API.
entries.notes: No permanent free plan; trial has full-screen watermark.

entries.name: Google Veo (Gemini API / Vertex AI)
entries.auth_hint: Gemini API: x-goog-api-key header or ?key= param. Vertex AI alternative uses cloud_iam (service-account OAuth2 access token).
entries.free_tier: no free tier for video; Veo generation requires a paid Gemini API / Vertex AI billing account
entries.desc_en: Generate video from text or image prompts via Gemini API (api key) or Vertex AI (cloud IAM), incl. Veo 3.1 scene extension.
entries.notes: Same underlying model reachable via two auth paths: Gemini API (simple api_key, good for agents) or Vertex AI (cloud_iam, enterprise/region control).

entries.name: HeyGen API
entries.auth_hint: API key: X-Api-Key: <key> (bills to API plan). OAuth2: Authorization: Bearer <token> via https://api2.heygen.com/v1/oauth/token (bills to user's subscription credits).
entries.free_tier: no free API credits since Feb 2026; pay-as-you-go from $5, $0.50-$0.99/credit. Free plan (3 videos/mo) exists but is for the web app, not standalone API.
entries.desc_en: Create AI avatar/talking-head videos from text or audio, manage avatars and voices, via REST API.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server uses OAuth (no API key needed) and spends the user's plan credits directly, separate from API-key billing.

entries.name: Klap API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (no free API tier found; consumer plans from $14/mo, API is usage-based)
entries.desc_en: Automatically turn long videos into short clips with captions and reframing via REST API.

entries.name: Kling AI API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <JWT> - JWT signed (HS256) client-side from an Access Key/Secret Key pair issued in the Kling Open Platform console
entries.free_tier: paid only; prepaid credit packages from $0.14/unit, e.g. 5,000 units/$700, 180-day validity
entries.desc_en: Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, lip-sync and video effects via REST API with JWT-signed requests.
entries.notes: Auth is JWT built from an Access/Secret key pair, not a static bearer token - more setup than typical API-key services.

entries.name: Luma AI Dream Machine API
entries.free_tier: paid only; pay-as-you-go, ~$0.60-$1.05 per 5s clip (Ray 2), $5,000/mo cap on default Build tier
entries.desc_en: Generate and extend AI videos from text or start/end keyframe images via async REST API (Ray 2).
entries.notes: API credits are separate from Dream Machine subscription credits (do not transfer); failed generations are refunded.

entries.name: MiniMax Hailuo API
entries.free_tier: new accounts get 50 signup credits (~1 short clip); 5s video costs ~45-70 credits, 1000 credits=$1
entries.desc_en: Async text-to-video, image-to-video and subject-reference video generation via REST API, up to 1080p.
entries.notes: Region-specific hosts/keys: platform.minimax.io / api.minimax.io vs intl.minimaxi.com for international accounts - key and host must match.

entries.name: Mux Video API
entries.free_tier: first 100,000 delivered minutes/month free, then usage-based
entries.desc_en: Upload, encode, stream and analyse video; get playback URLs, thumbnails and captions via REST.
entries.notes: Hosting/streaming infrastructure; does not generate video from prompts.

entries.name: PixVerse API
entries.auth_hint: API key from platform.pixverse.ai, sent as bearer/header per docs
entries.free_tier: paid only; prepaid credits from $10, ~$0.28-$0.45 per 5s clip
entries.desc_en: Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, transition and fusion clips (360p-1080p) via REST API.
entries.notes: Developer API credit pool (Essential/Scale/Business) is separate from consumer subscription plans.

entries.name: Runway API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> plus required X-Runway-Version header
entries.free_tier: no free tier; $10 minimum credit top-up, $0.01/credit
entries.desc_en: Generate and edit images/video (Gen-4.5) via async task-based REST API: submit, poll, download.
entries.notes: Docs site also offers /llms-small.txt and /llms-full.txt (not a plain llms.txt). Official MCP also usable from Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor.

entries.name: Shotstack API
entries.free_tier: 10 free credits (valid 30 days), then pay-as-you-go or subscription
entries.desc_en: Compose Edit JSON timelines to programmatically render, edit, and template videos, images and audio.
entries.notes: Separate stage (sandbox, watermarked) and production API keys; MCP server is in beta.

entries.name: Synthesia API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (no permanent free API tier; paid plans include API minutes)
entries.desc_en: Generate AI avatar talking-head videos from text scripts via REST API; supports custom avatars and voices.
entries.notes: API access tied to paid plans; base URL https://api.synthesia.io/v2.

entries.name: Tavus API
entries.desc_en: Create AI video replicas and real-time conversational video agents (CVI) via REST API.
entries.notes: llms_txt found at /llms-full.txt rather than /llms.txt exactly.
